cover.title: More local customers
cover.description: We do not sell loose services. We work toward one result: when someone searches for what your business offers, they find you first.

approach.title: Results, not loose services
approach.subtitle: A website, a few reviews or a Google profile do not bring customers on their own. The whole does, worked every month toward a single goal.

newWay.title: Buying a result
items: One team accountable for your customer acquisition
All the work points at showing up first in your area
Content, links, authority and reviews move together
A monthly report in plain language of what was done

approach.problemsTitle: What costs a local business customers today

problems.title: Invisible on Google
problems.description: If your business does not show up when someone searches for your service nearby, a competitor takes that call.

problems.title: Little visible reputation
problems.description: Few reviews, old ones or unanswered ones erode trust right before the customer decides.

problems.title: AI recommends someone else
problems.description: AI assistants answer with the businesses they recognize as the reference. That place has to be earned.

core.name: Local SEO
core.title: Everything it takes to rank your business
core.description: One monthly plan that brings together the work needed to gain visibility in local Google searches and in the answers AI engines give.

pillars.title: Authority content
pillars.description: The content that establishes your business as a reference in its field.

pillars.title: Backlinks and citations
pillars.description: Presence on trusted directories and citation websites.
items: For Google and for AI engines

pillars.title: Authority on Google and AI
pillars.description: Your business and your website as the reference that gets recommended.
items: On-page local SEO for your website
Presence in Google and AI results

pillars.title: Review management
pillars.description: Your reputation, measured and worked on month after month.

core.goal: The first position on Google for searches in your area. No provider can guarantee a specific ranking and we do not promise one: we commit to the work that leads there.

process.title: A clear process, month after month

steps.title: We learn where you stand
steps.description: We review your current presence on Google, your website, your reviews and who gets recommended in your area today.

steps.title: We work the four pillars
steps.description: Content, citations, authority and reviews move in parallel, on a plan you know in advance.

steps.title: We measure and adjust
steps.description: Every month you get a report in plain language and we adjust the work to what changed.
